quality.label: Process quality
quality.optimalDescription: Strength training, enough protein (~80% fat loss / ~50% fat gain)
quality.moderateDescription: Diet only, no strength training (~70% fat)
quality.poorDescription: Crash diet or uncontrolled surplus (~60% fat loss / ~80% fat gain)

goal.syncHint: Change either one — the other adjusts automatically.

currentStats.title: Your stats
currentStats.missingData: Fill in age, weight and height to see your numbers.

goalResults.dailyCalories: Eat per day to reach your goal
goalResults.note: Estimates assume 7,700 kcal per kg of body weight and a fat share of the change based on the chosen process quality. Not medical advice.

status.missingGoal: Enter a target weight and a date in the future.
status.maintain: Target equals your current weight — eat at maintenance.
status.belowBmr: Required intake is below your BMR ({bmr} kcal) — this pace is likely unsafe. Consider more days.
status.tooFastLoss: Faster than 1% of body weight per week — consider giving yourself more time.
status.tooFastGain: Gaining faster than 0.5% of body weight per week adds mostly fat.
status.ok: Sustainable pace — easy to keep up.
